summary: Practise DHIS2 installation, data entry, access and routine maintenance. Explore the five-day course and plan your training.
lede: DHIS2 training covers the practical setup and upkeep of routine health-data reporting workflows. It is for health information officers, system support staff and monitoring specialists who configure reporting or support users. Learners practise installation readiness, organization-unit and metadata setup, aggregate data entry, user access management and routine data-quality checks.
audienceIntro: This course suits health information teams who configure DHIS2 workflows, support users or prepare routine health reports. It is designed for professionals who need to carry out foundational platform tasks and document a workable maintenance approach.
prerequisites: No prior DHIS2 administration experience is required. Basic computer use and familiarity with routine health data workflows are helpful. Programming is not required.
